quotes.text: We always must unlock the primary key, because that's the one used for creating a new signature containing the expiration information.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Expiry editing must distinguish keys to unlock from keys whose expiry changes. A subkey expiry signature needs the primary secret key unlocked, plus the selected subkey when applicable. In D212003, automatic passphrase mode had already unlocked the primary while key details were open and masked the missing unlock. Test protected and unprotected keys, plus cached and cold unlock states when changing this path. Current RNP.changeKeyExpiration centralizes unlock/edit sets and releases trackers in finally. Validation here is source inspection and reported historical manual checks.
title: Unlock the signature authority even when editing a subkey
